items.prompt: Cinemagraph. Fixed tripod shot, the camera is completely static: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no dolly, the framing never changes. Only small ambient motion inside the scene: waterfalls flow, mist drifts slowly, fireflies twinkle, mushrooms glow softly, grass sways gently. The grassy clearing stays in the lower part of the frame the whole time.
